_comment: Hand decisions applied by build_plan.py; edit this file directly. day_starts = first verses of days 2-5 (MAM numbering). choice: keep = follow the optimizer (the owner accepted the automatic split; re-optimized on each run), strict = section breaks only, even = evener split, scene = hand-picked scene breaks (data/scene_options.json). The first 44 come from the 2026-11-07 review on the Leningrad Codex (record in data/review_*.json; at_decision.text = 'wlc'); exod-28 and the lev-14 update were decided on MAM on 2026-11-10. Lev 21 was also flagged on MAM; the owner kept the automatic split. 'problem' is why a seder was reviewed, 'chosen_option_note' describes the pick; only Bĕreʾshith 16 has an owner comment ('modification').
